ben: I’ll take JS snippets and the init rename. Which files?
tara: docs/sdk/js/overview.md and samples/quickstart-js.md. Also a couple anchors in whats-new moved; docs-bot flagged them.
ci-bot: linkcheck: 4 failed anchors, logs attached to PR 6432.
ben: Will update JS to `new Redwood()` and add a one-line migration note. PR 6438.
qa-lee: Tag me when snippets are up. I’ll run a quick smoke on staging (short + long generate). Note: watch streaming fallback in APAC.
tara: Draft changelog bullets: SDK client rename; param rename (max_len -> max_tokens); anchor fixes; known issue: streaming partials in APAC.
ben: Pushed PR 6438. Adding a redirect stub for the top anchor to avoid flakiness.
tara: Great — once CI passes and QA signs off I’ll merge the whats-new and publish the changelog.
